item.text: I found that deleted comments are included in the count, the deletion listener targets the wrong search document kind, and issue archiving leaves comment documents behind. The rebuild also includes archived content and stops after the first page. I’ll fix those paths and make the rebuild replace only the requested workspace’s index.
